title: Vacuum
text: Vacuum. The vacuum is lightweight and easy to handle but the pick-up ability leaves something to be desired. I would not purchase again or recommend it.

The Featherweight stick vacuum can be used on low pile carpets, area rugs and hard floors for quick clean-ups around the house. Since it’s so lightweight, it’s ideal for keeping on-hand in a nearby closet so you can use it anytime you notice some dirt on the floor. Since its foot is easily removed, you can use it on above-floor surfaces like furniture and countertops as well. Attach the crevice tool to clean hard-to-reach area
Life can be hard on carpets. That’s why BISSELL vacuums are designed to make it easier to get carpets clean and soft, so you can get on with life

Keep your floors clean and crumb-free with stick vacuums from BISSELL. They’re perfect for quick, everyday cleanup of dirt and debris on hard floors and area rugs. Plus, boost the convenience by keeping one on each floor of your home.

The BISSELL Featherweight Bagless lightweight vacuum is great for quick clean-ups of everyday messes. It offers the benefit of a lightweight floor vacuum plus the convenience of a hand vacuum by removing the quick-release handle, and the included crevice tools provides effortless cleaning in tight places.  The small size of the Featherweight Bagless allows cleaning in a variety of locations. Use it for quick pick-ups in the kitchen, living room, and other areas around the home.  The Featherweight is also bagless so there are no bags to buy, it features an Easy to Empty dirt cup that makes clean up a breeze, and offers a 1 year limited warranty.
